about.title: About us
about.intro: Safaar is an online platform for booking hotels across Uzbekistan. Our goal is to make travel easy, reliable and affordable for everyone.
about.mission: By bringing local hotels together on a single platform, we offer customers transparent prices and a convenient booking experience.

values.title: Trust
values.text: Every booking is safe and guaranteed. Prices are transparent, with no hidden fees.

values.title: Convenience
values.text: Book a hotel in a few steps — from any device.

values.title: Local focus
values.text: Built for the Uzbek market: payments in soum, service in Uzbek.

help.subtitle: Frequently asked questions

faqs.q: How do I make a booking?
faqs.a: Search for a hotel, choose the right option and click "Book". Confirmation is done via an SMS code sent to your phone number.
You can pay via Click, Payme, Uzcard, Humo or cash. The payment method is selected during booking.
Yes, you can cancel a booking in the "My bookings" section of your account. Refund terms depend on the selected fare.
Bonuses are earned for every booking. Accumulated bonuses can be used on future bookings.

sections.heading: 1. General terms
sections.body: By using the Safaar platform, you agree to these terms. The platform acts as an intermediary for booking hotel services.

sections.heading: 2. Booking and payment
sections.body: All prices are shown in Uzbek soum (UZS). A booking takes effect once payment is made or confirmed.

sections.heading: 3. Cancellation and refunds
sections.body: Cancellation terms depend on the service provider's fare. Refund amounts are calculated according to the selected cancellation policy.

sections.heading: 4. Privacy
sections.body: Your personal data is used only to provide services and is not disclosed to third parties.

sections.heading: 4. User Categories and Interactions
sections.body:
4.1. Partner

4.1.1. The Partner operates as an independent entrepreneur or legal entity and is personally responsible for compliance with legal requirements, including tourism and tax legislation.

4.1.2. The partner independently determines the price of his object, the number of available places, discount conditions, cancellation policy and other commercial conditions through the appropriate section of the "SAFAAR" application and is responsible for their relevance.

4.2. Customer

4.2.1. When making a reservation through a mobile application or web platform, the Client must correctly and accurately provide the type of accommodation, periods, number of guests and other necessary information.

4.2.2. The Client agrees to visit the facility within the agreed period, to communicate with the Partner and to fulfill payment obligations on time.

4.3. Specific rights and obligations between the Company, the Partner and the Client are formed on the basis of this Offer, the Privacy Policy, as well as the additional rules specified in the appendix.

sections.heading: 5. Pricing, Currency and Payment for System Service
sections.body:
5.1. All prices and calculations are usually made in soums, the national currency of the Republic of Uzbekistan.

5.2. Cost of accommodation and recreation services

5.2.1. The partner independently determines the price of using his facility through a special section of the "SAFAAR" application. Tariffs, seasonal prices, promotional offers, discounts and other commercial conditions are determined by the Partner and are indicated in the application.

5.2.2. The Company is not responsible for the cost of accommodation or recreation services; The prices displayed to the Client are the commercial terms established by the Partner.

5.3. System Service Fee (Company Revenue)

5.3.1. The Company charges the Partner as a system service fee (commission) in the amount of [___]% (specify the percentage) of the amount of each successful booking.

5.3.2. The payment for the system service is calculated from the sum of the total payments received by the Partner for bookings received through SAFAAR. The calculation formula and practical mechanism (withholding, periodic mutual calculations, etc.) are technically implemented in the system and displayed on the Partner's interface.

5.3.3. The company has the right to partially or completely not charge the fee for the system service for a certain period of time, set it at 0% or introduce other preferential conditions based on a special promotion, advertising campaign or internal decision under the "SAFAAR" project.

5.4. Payment for SMS subscription service

5.4.1. The customer can connect to the SMS subscription service according to his wish, in which the monthly subscription fee is charged according to the tariff specified in the "SAFAAR" application.

5.4.2. The SMS subscription service is voluntary and the Customer has the right to unsubscribe at any time through the application. In case of cancellation, no fee will be charged for the next billing period.

5.4.3. If the law stipulates a special procedure for taxes, mandatory payments or other fees, the Company and the Partner must act in accordance with such requirements.

sections.heading: 6. Payment Procedures and Refunds
sections.body:
6.1. Payment methods

6.1.1. The customer has the right to pay in the following ways:

by cash to the Partner upon arrival at the facility (if the Partner supports such a method);

Online payment through payment systems integrated into the SAFAAR system (UzCard, Humo, Click, Payme, Uzum Bank and other payment organizations).

6.1.2. Available payment methods and their description are shown separately in the application. The Company reserves the right to add, change or cancel individual payment methods for technical or commercial reasons.

6.2. Booking time and payment

6.2.1. The payment method (advance payment, payment at the facility, etc.) may be determined depending on the Partner's policy and the specific situation and will be displayed in the application interface.

6.2.2. The client is obliged to make the payment on time in accordance with the chosen method and conditions.

6.3. Cancellation and Return Policy

6.3.1. Each Partner independently determines the terms and conditions of cancellation of reservations for its object (free cancellation period, partial or full non-refundable payments, etc.) and these conditions are clearly indicated to the Client through the application before booking.

6.3.2. If the accommodation or vacation service is not properly provided (for example, the facility is not available as described or is unreasonably refused by the Partner), the Company and the Partner will consider the situation separately, taking into account the legal rights and interests of the Client. Refunds or other types of compensation may be applied when there are grounds provided for by law.

6.3.3. In case of late cancellation or no-show by the client, the Company and the Partner have the right to refuse a full or partial refund in accordance with the cancellation policy established by the Partner, unless otherwise provided by law.

6.4. Payment security and fraud protection

6.4.1. Online payments made through the SAFAAR system are processed using the protected infrastructure of banks and payment organizations (Click, Payme, Uzum Bank, etc.).

6.4.2. Bank card data of users are processed directly by payment organizations and banks. "SAFAAR" system does not store these data and does not have full access to them.

6.4.3. To increase the security of payments, 3D Secure (3DS) technology, which provides additional confirmation of transactions (SMS-code, confirmation through the bank's mobile application, etc.), can be used.

6.4.4. In order to prevent fraudulent transactions, automatic detection and temporary blocking of suspicious transactions, limitation of repeated payment attempts from the same card, monitoring of user activity and additional checks may be used if necessary.

6.4.5. The user must independently ensure the security of his payment means: not to give bank card information to third parties; do not share verification codes (SMS, 3DS) with others; make payments only from trusted devices and networks.

6.4.6. In case of suspicion of unauthorized use of the card, the user must contact his bank and payment organization immediately.

6.4.7. The Company reserves the right to temporarily limit or terminate user operations when signs of fraud are detected.

sections.heading: 7. Acceptance of the offer and conclusion of the contract
sections.body:
7.1. This Offer is public and is considered a contract concluded from the moment of acceptance by the User in the prescribed manner.

7.2. The user is deemed to have accepted (accepted) the terms of the Offer when he performs one or more of the following actions:

Register to use the SAFAAR mobile application/web platform (Partner or Client Interface);

booking accommodation or vacation services by clicking "Confirm reservation", "I confirm" or similar buttons;

Payment through the "SAFAAR" system.

7.3. From the moment of acceptance, the User confirms that he has familiarized himself with this Offer, the Privacy Policy and other rules specified in the "SAFAAR" system and fully agrees with them.

7.4. If the User does not agree with the terms of the Offer, he must immediately stop using the "SAFAAR" mobile application and web platform.

sections.heading: 8. Rights and obligations of the parties
9. Liability and force majeure
10. Dispute Resolution Procedure
sections.body:
10.1. Procedure before the court

10.1.1. The Parties shall attempt to resolve all disputes, disputes and claims arising out of or related to this Offer primarily through negotiation and written submissions.

10.1.2. The Customer or Partner may submit a claim or complaint to the Company through the following channels:

e-mail: support@safaar.uz (confirm the exact address);

support Telegram-bot: @safaar_support (confirm the exact channel).

10.1.3. It is recommended to indicate the following in the claim/complaint as much as possible: F.I.Sh. or user ID, user type, contact information, nature of the dispute, date of the incident, relevant screenshots and other materials confirming the circumstances.

10.1.4. The Company usually considers such appeals within 30 (thirty) calendar days and informs the User about the results.

10.2. Judicial procedure

10.2.1. If the dispute cannot be resolved before the court, the dispute will be considered in the competent court of the place where the Company is registered in accordance with the legislation of the Republic of Uzbekistan.

10.2.2. This Offer, its construction, validity, interpretation and cancellation shall be governed by the current legislation of the Republic of Uzbekistan.

sections.heading: 11. Final Provisions
sections.body:
11.1. This Offer comes into force from the moment it is published by the Company (for example, on the "SAFAAR" mobile application or official information channels) and is valid as a contract from the moment it is accepted by the User.

11.2. The company has the right to change or update the text of the Offer, taking into account legal requirements, system development and other objective reasons. The updated version will be effective from the moment it is posted at the posted address, unless otherwise specified.

11.3. Continuing to use the "SAFAAR" system after the updated Offer is published usually confirms that the User has read and agreed with the new version.

11.4. If individual provisions of the Offer are found to be invalid or unenforceable as a result of legislative changes or decisions of competent authorities, this does not mean that the rest of the Offer is invalid. The rest of the rules will remain in effect.

11.5. This Offer applies in conjunction with the Privacy Policy and other rules of the "SAFAAR" system. In the case of conflicts regarding the processing of personal data, the provisions that protect the User's rights at a higher level usually take precedence.

Samarkand district, 2026
